assigned_features.name: Tag-based document categorization
assigned_features.description: Users can add/remove tags on documents. GET /api/documents/{id}/tags returns the list; POST /api/documents/{id}/tags adds a tag; DELETE /api/documents/{id}/tags/{tag} removes one. Tags are user-scoped (a user can't add tags to another user's document). Validation: tag is 1-32 chars, alphanumeric + dashes only.

# Feature Design: Tag-based document categorization

## Summary
Users can attach short text tags to their documents for organization.

## Acceptance Criteria (must be ≤4)

AC1. POST /api/documents/{id}/tags adds a tag to the document; returns 201 with {"tag": "<value>"}.
     Verify: `curl -sS -X POST -H 'X-API-Key: k1' -H 'Content-Type: application/json' -d '{"tag":"urgent"}' http://localhost:8000/api/documents/1/tags | python3 -c "import json,sys; d=json.load(sys.stdin); assert d['tag']=='urgent'; print('OK')"`
     Expected: `OK`
     Test: `test_tag_create_returns_201`.

AC2. GET /api/documents/{id}/tags returns 200 with a JSON array of tag strings.
     Verify: `curl -sS -H 'X-API-Key: k1' http://localhost:8000/api/documents/1/tags | python3 -c "import json,sys; d=json.load(sys.stdin); assert isinstance(d,list); print('OK')"`
     Expected: `OK`
     Test: `test_tag_list_returns_array`.

AC3. Cross-user access returns 404 (not 403, to avoid existence-leak).
     Verify: `curl -sS -o /dev/null -w '%{http_code}' -H 'X-API-Key: k_other' http://localhost:8000/api/documents/1/tags`
     Expected: `404`
     Test: `test_tag_cross_user_returns_404`.

AC4. Invalid tag (>32 chars or non-alphanumeric) returns 400.
     Verify: `curl -sS -o /dev/null -w '%{http_code}' -X POST -H 'X-API-Key: k1' -H 'Content-Type: application/json' -d '{"tag":"!!!"}' http://localhost:8000/api/documents/1/tags`
     Expected: `400`
     Test: `test_tag_invalid_returns_400`.
